# Universal Adventures

> > Universal Adventures is India's premier tour and adventure booking platform offering curated travel packages across destinations like Kerala, Rajasthan, Karnataka, Himachal Pradesh, and beyond.

Universal Adventures specializes in family tours, adventure activities, temple tours, camping experiences, and multi-day itineraries across India. The platform provides comprehensive tour packages with accommodation, guided tours, and adventure sports including trekking, water sports, camping, and cultural experiences with competitive 2026 deals and pricing.
